prompt: Give one tip for better sleep.
response: One effective tip for better sleep is to establish a consistent bedtime routine. This involves going to bed and waking up at the same time every day, including weekends. By creating a regular sleep schedule, your body will begin to recognize when it's time to wind down and prepare for sleep. Additionally, ensuring that your bedroom is conducive to sleeping (cool, dark, quiet, comfortable bedding) can also help improve the quality of your sleep.
